scoreBefore.style: English, A sensual, slow-jam R&B track built on a foundation of deep sub-bass and crisp trap-style drum machine percussion with prominent snaps and hi-hats. The chorus introduces layered harmonies and soaring falsetto ad-libs over atmospheric synth pads. A brief bridge features breathy female vocals before transitioning into a passionate saxophone solo accompanied by spoken word whispers, enhancing the romantic and immersive atmosphere., 69 bpm, E minor, 4/4 time
